raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions does not normalize them. v2 rows are therefore shifted about 6 hours late, which pushes evening local transactions into the next UTC date (the 31 rows on 2026-01-19 are v2 rows at 00:00-05:00 UTC) and creates the apparent 00:00-06:00 activity. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago local time, and deriving txn_date from the converted value, should fix the volume and time-distribution alerts.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t;"}}
